scenarios.stimulus: rst_n/local_rst_n asserted
scenarios.observed_behavior: protection_fsm resets to ST_NORMAL with fault_latched=0, fault_code_latched=FAULT_NONE, pwm_disable=0; pwm_gen separately drives pwm_raw low while reset is asserted
scenarios.target_gap: Reset release must enter safe RESET_WAIT rather than an immediately armed conceptual state.

scenarios.stimulus: clear_fault observed in ST_FAULT_LATCHED
scenarios.observed_behavior: state changes to ST_RESET_WAIT, counter clears, latch and pwm_disable remain asserted; this is the only current RESET_WAIT entry
scenarios.target_gap: Reset assertion and legal clear must both enter the sample-qualified target RESET_WAIT.

scenarios.stimulus: fault_valid=0 and clear_fault=0 for RESET_WAIT_CYCLES clock edges
scenarios.observed_behavior: counter advances on every clock, not every accepted sample; exit clears latch/code on the terminal edge and pwm_disable releases on the following registered edge
scenarios.target_gap: Exit must require one eligible healthy raw evaluation and hold safe until registered arming.

scenarios.stimulus: first accepted sample_valid destination delivery after local reset release
scenarios.observed_behavior: sample_accept_event is rst_n && sample_valid; first accepted pair enters the pipeline immediately on the first eligible clock edge
scenarios.target_gap: The first transaction must be explicitly tied to RESET_WAIT qualification and reset flush.

scenarios.stimulus: first accepted raw pair evaluates nonzero protection indicators
scenarios.observed_behavior: comparator/health pipeline produces registered fault_valid/code and ST_NORMAL latches the code; current response is a fixed implementation pipeline, not a named episode event
scenarios.target_gap: Capture first code and full bitmap once per episode, including a fault during RESET_WAIT.

scenarios.stimulus: no accepted raw transaction after reset release
scenarios.observed_behavior: FSM remains ST_NORMAL and does not wait for a sample; if pwm_enable is asserted, pwm_gen may run after reset even though no healthy transaction has been observed
scenarios.target_gap: Remain in safe RESET_WAIT indefinitely until one eligible healthy raw evaluation.

scenarios.stimulus: same physical cause remains present across accepted transactions
scenarios.observed_behavior: fault_valid can be asserted on each qualifying transaction, while ST_FAULT_LATCHED keeps protection disabled; no explicit one-event-per-episode suppression exists
scenarios.target_gap: Persistent fault must not retrigger first-cause event within an episode.

scenarios.stimulus: later accepted raw evaluation is healthy
scenarios.observed_behavior: fault_valid/code return to the classifier's no-fault output after pipeline drain, but fault_latched and latched code remain asserted
scenarios.target_gap: Source removal must update live bitmap but never clear the latch or end the episode without legal clear.

scenarios.stimulus: clear_fault asserted while fault_valid is high or the source remains faulting
scenarios.observed_behavior: ST_FAULT_LATCHED unconditionally enters ST_RESET_WAIT on clear; a later registered fault can re-latch, so rejection is an emergent pipeline effect rather than an explicit acceptance predicate
scenarios.target_gap: Clear must be explicitly rejected while live_fault_bitmap is nonzero or invalid.

scenarios.stimulus: healthy accepted evaluation followed by clear_fault
scenarios.observed_behavior: clear enters cycle-counted RESET_WAIT; no sample is required for progress and the latch clears on the terminal count
scenarios.target_gap: Legal clear must require a valid healthy observation and return to sample-qualified RESET_WAIT.

scenarios.stimulus: fault_valid and clear_fault asserted together
scenarios.observed_behavior: in ST_RESET_WAIT fault_valid is tested before clear/progress; in ST_FAULT_LATCHED the clear branch is unconditional, so priority depends on current state
scenarios.target_gap: Freeze one state-independent FAULT > CLEAR policy.

scenarios.stimulus: a later cause appears after an initial fault
scenarios.observed_behavior: while ST_FAULT_LATCHED, later fault_valid does not overwrite code; during ST_RESET_WAIT, fault_valid overwrites fault_code_latched; after recovery, a new fault can latch
scenarios.target_gap: First cause must be immutable across the entire episode, including recovery qualification.

scenarios.stimulus: multiple raw causes asserted on one evaluated transaction
scenarios.observed_behavior: fault_classifier emits one code using executable priority; remaining causes are not observable through the code or status
scenarios.target_gap: Preserve all primitive causes in first/live/seen internal bitmaps while retaining deterministic code priority.

scenarios.stimulus: rst_n/local_rst_n asserted while protection is latched
scenarios.observed_behavior: asynchronous reset clears FSM, classifier, health history, and PWM state; after release the FSM is immediately ST_NORMAL rather than RESET_WAIT
scenarios.target_gap: Reset must dominate and restart a safe sample-qualified episode boundary.

scenarios.stimulus: reset asserted while ST_RESET_WAIT and counter has progress
scenarios.observed_behavior: asynchronous reset discards counter/latch/code and returns ST_NORMAL; stale recovery progress does not revive
scenarios.target_gap: Discard recovery progress and restart RESET_WAIT, with pending raw/normalized transactions flushed.

scenarios.stimulus: first accepted raw transaction after clear-driven RESET_WAIT
scenarios.observed_behavior: transaction pipeline continues while FSM waits on a clock counter; a fault can re-latch on any recovery edge, and a healthy/no-sample path can complete solely by elapsed clocks
scenarios.target_gap: Define the first post-clear eligible evaluation as the new episode qualification boundary.

scenarios.stimulus: a healthy evaluated transaction retires, followed by an ACLK edge with no retiring transaction
scenarios.observed_behavior: fault_classifier registers fault_valid=0 and FAULT_NONE for both situations; no separate valid distinguishes a completed healthy evaluation from pipeline idle
scenarios.target_gap: Add fault_eval_valid so zero bitmap is an explicit healthy evaluation and never infer health from fault_valid=0.

scenarios.stimulus: one atomic raw CDC destination delivery enters the protection core
scenarios.observed_behavior: the pair is captured at edge offset 0, comparator and health decisions are captured at offset 1, classifier fault presence/code registers at offset 2, and the FSM consumes those registered outputs at offset 3; a new pair may enter every ACLK
scenarios.target_gap: Carry valid, sequence, bitmap, code, and integrity through the same fixed three-edge II=1 path.

scenarios.stimulus: clear_fault is captured in ST_FAULT_LATCHED on an edge where registered fault_valid/code are also available
scenarios.observed_behavior: the latched-state clear branch does not inspect fault_valid and unconditionally enters ST_RESET_WAIT, so there is no request boundary or ownership rule for the evaluation on that edge
scenarios.target_gap: Treat the same-edge retirement as earlier than the new request and resolve only with the first retirement on a strictly later edge.

scenarios.stimulus: clear_fault arrives after an accepted raw destination delivery but before that transaction reaches the FSM
scenarios.observed_behavior: clear can enter ST_RESET_WAIT before the three-edge raw result is consumed; a later fault_valid can then re-latch and overwrite the recovery code, but no explicit fence associates it with the request
scenarios.target_gap: Resolve the pending clear with that transaction when it retires after the request, regardless of its earlier destination-delivery edge.

scenarios.stimulus: one evaluated transaction is delivered every ACLK while software issues clear
scenarios.observed_behavior: the current FSM has no clear_pending state and no retirement fence; it immediately enters a cycle-counted RESET_WAIT, where repeated fault_valid activity can re-latch and healthy activity is indistinguishable from idle
scenarios.target_gap: Guarantee bounded clear resolution on the next retirement edge without requiring a globally empty pipeline.

scenarios.stimulus: reset asserts with captured or decision-stage raw work pending
scenarios.observed_behavior: asynchronous reset clears accepted_sample_valid, sample_decision_valid, classifier outputs, and FSM state, so current pipeline state is discarded; there is still no explicit completion-valid identity to assert against after reset
scenarios.target_gap: Reset must invalidate every future fault_eval valid stage so no pre-reset sequence retires post-reset.
